whenToUse: Preview lists, such as recommended products or recently viewed items.
People don't need to see every item.
whenNotToUse: People need to compare every item (use a grid).
Important content would be cut off and hidden.
It would advance on its own (the accessibility problems of carousels).
accessibility: The row is a named region that takes focus and scrolls with the arrow keys.
Previous and next buttons are named and turn off at the ends.
With scroll-snap, cards stop aligned to their slots.
Smooth scrolling turns off with reduced motion.
